services-Salon-interior-designer.intro: Rajokri sits right on NH-48, with Vasant Kunj, Mahipalpur and the Gurgaon border all close by. Salons here draw local residents, farmhouse families and a fair number of wedding guests during the season. As a salon interior designer, we plan spaces that can serve a regular haircut client and a full bridal party on the same afternoon.
cards: Neighbourhood Salons in the Village

Inside the village, shops tend to be small, with low ceilings and limited frontage. We make them feel larger with a light colour scheme, wall-mounted stations, mirrors on facing walls and recessed lights instead of bulky fittings. A single wash basin at the back, with a partition for privacy, often fits better than a separate wash room.

Simple, sturdy materials keep running costs low.
Bridal Suites for the Wedding Season

Many weddings in the farmhouses around Rajokri start with a salon visit. A salon interior designer can turn a back room into a bridal suite with a large lit mirror, a comfortable chair for long sessions, a changing space, a sofa for family members and a clean wall for photos.

Good lighting here is essential, because makeup must look right both indoors and under stage lights.
features: Comfort for Clients and Staff

Long sessions such as colouring, keratin or bridal makeup can run for hours. Chairs need to be well padded and adjustable, and footrests make a real difference. Staff need anti-fatigue mats at stations, a small rest corner and storage that keeps tools within reach. Strong cooling, quiet fans and fresh air keep everyone comfortable in summer, when the highway heat is intense.
process: Planning Your Salon Step by Step

We visit the shop, take measurements and check water supply, drainage and the electrical load. Our salon interior designer team then shares a layout with station positions and a 3D view of the finished look.

After you approve a budget, we manage plumbing, wiring, false ceiling, flooring, furniture, mirrors and signboards, and hand over a salon that is ready for its first client.

services-architecture-services.introHeading: Building Near the Airport and the Expressway
services-architecture-services.intro: Rajokri is a place of contrasts. The old village has tight lanes and mixed-use buildings, while the surrounding land holds some of Delhi's largest farmhouses, close to the airport and the Gurgaon border. Our architecture services cover both, with designs that respond to noise, heat, access and the local building rules.
cards: Farmhouse Estates

On a large estate, the arrangement of buildings matters as much as their design. We place the main house, guest cottages, staff quarters, garages and party lawns so that private areas stay quiet when events are on. Driveways are planned for cars, catering vans and emergency access.

Wide verandas, courtyards and shaded walkways make the outdoors usable for more of the year.

Pool houses, staff blocks and the generator room are placed downwind and out of the main views.
Village Plots and Mixed-Use Buildings

Inside the village, plots are small and roads narrow. Our architecture services here focus on safe structure, a compact stair, ground-floor shops or parking and rented units above, all within the limits of the plot and with proper fire escape.

Where shops face the main road, we design shutters, signage space and a loading point that will not block traffic.
features: Designing for Aircraft Noise and Highway Heat

Being close to the airport means regular aircraft noise. We use double-glazed windows, solid doors, insulated roofs and careful placement of bedrooms to keep homes quiet. The open land around Rajokri also gets very hot in summer, so we plan deep overhangs, light-coloured roofs, shaded west walls and cross-ventilation.

Rainwater harvesting and good drainage are part of every site plan.

Estates often need underground tanks and a water treatment plant, so we plan them with easy access for servicing.
process: Our Architecture Process

We begin with a site visit, a measured survey and a discussion of your needs and budget. Concept options and 3D massing studies follow, then detailed drawings for structure, services and finishes.

During construction, our architecture services include regular site checks, coordination with engineers and contractors, and support with the interiors until handover.

services-architecture-services.whyIntro: Large sites and tight village plots both need clear thinking at the start. We sort out access, utilities and permissions early, so construction moves without long pauses. We also prepare the drawings needed for approvals and keep a record of every revision.
whyText: Experience with estates as well as compact plots.
Buildings designed for strength, comfort and good looks.
Involvement from the first survey to final handover.
whyMore: Glazing and layouts that cut aircraft noise.
Shade, insulation and airflow built in.

services-modern-interior-design.introHeading: Modern Interiors for Rajokri's Homes and Estates
services-modern-interior-design.intro: From new floors in the village to glass-fronted farmhouses on the estates, many owners in Rajokri want a clean, current look. The challenge is to keep it warm and practical in a dusty, hot climate.
cards: Modern Floors and Apartments

In compact homes, we use flush cabinets, wall-hung units and multi-use furniture to keep floors clear. A soft base palette of white, beige or grey is lifted with one or two accent colours. Lighting is mostly hidden, with coves and downlights, plus a statement pendant over the dining table.

Sliding doors save space and keep rooms flexible.

Kids' rooms get bright bedding or one coloured wall, while bunk beds and study desks keep the floor free for play.

Inside, a long kitchen island often becomes the centre of family life, with the dining table close by and views to the pool or garden.

Clean lines show dust easily, so we pick surfaces that wipe clean and resist marks. Matte surfaces hide fingerprints better than gloss. Large windows get good shading and, near the airport, double glazing for quiet. Warm textures such as wood, linen and wool stop the space from feeling cold, and plants bring life to plain walls.

Good modern rooms do not need a big budget. Furniture of the right size, one well-chosen light and tidy storage do more than costly imported pieces.

features: Comfort in Everyday Details

Bedrooms away from the road and flight paths where possible, with heavy curtains and double glazing if needed. Kitchens with space for large cooking pots and bulk storage. Bathrooms with good slopes and exhaust. A place for shoes, bags and keys at the door. A small study corner for children. These small things shape how a home feels every day.

Terraces and balconies get weather-proof flooring and a tap, so plants and drying clothes are easy to manage.
process: Building Your Home Interior

The first meeting is at your home, with as many family members as possible. Measurements, photos and a list of must-haves go back to our residential interior design team, who return with floor plans, 3D views and costs for each room.

Once work starts, a supervisor runs the site and sends you progress photos, and we finish with a joint walk-through so nothing is missed.

services-top-interior-design-firm.introHeading: A Firm Built on Process and Follow-Through
services-top-interior-design-firm.intro: Owners in Rajokri handle a wide mix of projects: family homes, rental floors, estates and highway businesses. A top interior design firm for this area needs the range to handle all of them and the discipline to deliver each one well. We focus on planning, site control and clear communication on every job.
cards: Residential Work

From a single floor to a full estate, every room, from the modular kitchen to the master bath, is drawn as part of one connected plan. Detailed drawings guide every trade on site, so what you approve is what gets built.

Loose furniture, soft furnishings and artwork can be added so the home is ready on day one.
Commercial and Hospitality Work

Showrooms, offices and guest houses near the airport need quick, careful execution. A top interior design firm plans these around your business calendar, keeps quality steady across large areas and coordinates with your brand team.

For guest houses, we can stage the work floor by floor so some rooms keep earning during the renovation.
features: Standards We Hold Ourselves To

Drawings for every room before work begins. Samples approved in writing. A supervisor on site daily. Quality checks at set stages. A snag list closed before handover. A file with warranties, care guides and contact numbers for future service. These standards keep projects on track and clients confident.

We also keep a simple log of who visited the site and what was done each day, which you can ask to see at any time.
process: Our Way of Delivering Projects

Every project moves through the same checkpoints: an agreed brief, measured drawings, a design you can see in 3D, a priced material list, then site work and a formal handover. You approve each checkpoint before we move on, which is how a top interior design firm keeps costs and timelines honest.

If you want something changed midway, we give you the cost and time impact in writing first.
